Package game.crops

Class Cauliflower

java.lang.Object
edu.monash.fit2099.engine.GameEntity
edu.monash.fit2099.engine.positions.Ground
game.crops.Crop
game.crops.Cauliflower
All Implemented Interfaces:
Printable, Harvestable, FreelyWaterable, Waterable
public class Cauliflower extends Crop implements Waterable
A cauliflower crop. Watering it may turn the surrounding ground into puddles, and it can only be harvested once it has been watered enough times.
